text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having defeated her rival, Mihono Bourbon 
runs the Tenno Sho (Spring) to the very 
end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Experiencing the emotion of "joy" for the 
first time... She struggled to process it, 
feeling bewildered.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Longing to once again feel the "joy" that 
victory brings, Mihono Bourbon—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She moved on toward the Japan Cup, where 
her formidable rival Tokai Teio was 
expected to run.
